snippet.title: Miniopolis - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at the Miniopolis announcement trailer for this upcoming resource-free city-building sandbox game, where you can build the way you want. Create, shape, and customize a miniature metropolis with intuitive and satisfying tools. Construct towering cityscapes, fine-tune their look and layout, and give every structure its own distinctive character. Miniopolis will be available on PC (via Steam). A demo is coming soon.
